title: Cloud Engineer
description: Design and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure. Build Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. Deploy Kubernetes workloads. Troubleshoot Linux servers. Collaborate with DevOps teams. AWS Solutions Architect certification is preferred.

title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
description: Support AI training infrastructure using Docker and Kubernetes. Deploy machine learning workloads on AWS. Experience with GPU environments, Python, MLOps, and TensorFlow is highly desirable.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins. Automate cloud deployments with Terraform. Manage Docker containers on AWS. Monitor Linux systems and improve deployment reliability.
